body: ac-0: pin the cede/keep/exclude partition + recovery audit. Classify all 244 model-predicted leaves: CEDE (closed-set/checksum/format-exclusive, value-self-sufficient, recovery ships or buildable) vs EXCLUDE (open-vocab over-emitters, guardrail 1) vs KEEP (broad-shape model arbitration). For every cede leaf confirm a shipping deterministic recovery path. Output: explicit partition doc + needs-new-rule gap list (feeds ac-1).

ac-0 DONE. Partition pinned in output/model-label-space-reshape/ac0_partition.md (wf_9a28f0ad-47a, 16 agents). CEDE_CLEAN 125 / CEDE_GATED 38 / EXCLUDE 23 / KEEP 58. Conservative safe-to-cede = 134 leaves -> 244-to-110 classes (RECOMMENDED). Guardrail-1 PASS (0 open-vocab in cede; all 12 named leaves in EXCLUDE). All 4 thesis over-emitters ceded. Verified datetime delimited-vs-bare recovery vs mod.rs:2338. ac-1 NEEDS_NEW_RULE backlog = 21 checksum-identifier leaves; 8 bare epoch/compact held KEEP.

ac-2: over-emit measurement of the reshaped 111-class model. Reshape retrain running (task bh6eic9cu, models/m2v8m-reshape110-s43, seed 43, n_classes 245->111, from m2v8m-244.ftmb + --cede-labels). When done: inject type_index_keys, predict_multibranch on corpus, compare over-emit band vs shipped s43 baseline. Go/no-go = do the synthetic/format-leaf over-emit triggers vanish AND does FP mass NOT relocate to kept neighbours (destination drift).

Retrain DONE: 57 epochs, early-stop, val_acc 0.892, label_map 111 classes, 0 ceded leaves in head (ac-1 round-trip verified). type_index_keys injected. Reshaped raw Sense gold = 0.394 (EXPECTED floor — recovery rule not built, ceded-leaf gold cols unrecovered; not a regression). ac-2 corpus over-emit: built 12.7k corpus-sample TSV, potion-8M FTMB building (task b3i5ertcl). Next: predict reshaped + s43 on it, compare emission distributions for destination drift.

ac-2 DONE (raw Sense, 11.2k corpus cols, surgical valid_dim align). QUALIFIED not clean GO: targeted over-emitters vanish (isbn 98->0, si_number 22->0, currency_code 14->0; all 134 ceded->0 clean). But ~43% of freed mass relocates to specific kept leaves with NEW over-emission (npi +94, country_code +70, coords +64, tsid +63, lei +27); ~57% benign residual. Net value hinges on ac-3 (value-based recovery catches ceded cols regardless of drift dest). Result: output/model-label-space-reshape/ac2/RESULT.md. Note: drift concentrates in held-back checksum leaves (npi,lei) — ceding those too would close it.

ac-3 composed gold DONE. Recovery rule (ceded_leaf_recovery, 51 conclusive leaves) gold-CLEAN: s43 rule-on==rule-off 794/931=0.853 identical, zero over-fire, 2 unit tests pass, committed 44dbb21. BUT reshaped-111+recovery 775/931=0.832 = -2.1pp vs s43 (within CI, NOT parity-or-better). Net -19 cols driven by reshaped MODEL not the rule: alphanumeric_id->word residual shift (9, maybe seed variance), attractor drift to held-back ndc/docker_ref/country_code (recovery can't catch). Thesis not confirmed on gold at single seed. Options: 3-seed retrain (variance vs real cost), close url->docker_ref + cede ndc, or accept as simplicity/over-emit value at ~2pp gold cost. ac3/RESULT.md.

ac-2/ac-3 CLOSED — reshape NO-GO. 3-seed retrain decisive: composed gold 0.811/0.832/0.792 (mean 0.812) vs s43 0.853 = -4.1pp mean, all 3 below baseline (NOT variance). Recovery rule gold-clean; loss is the reshaped MODEL degrading on kept classes + data-reduction confound (131k->87k). choice 0108 REJECTED, memory reshape-leaf-drop-costs-gold, VERDICT.md.
